blocking.fail_if: single scene has more than 1 primary visual focus
important PPT/report/result is shown too small to read; use 85%-95% canvas width when needed
main presenter visible height <70% or demo presenter <65%
demo laptop visible width <68% of canvas
any product UI pixel visibly spills outside laptop screen

scene resembles PPT/government-report/template collage instead of modern SaaS launch visual
S01/S02/S04/S05/S07/S10/S12 stills are not reviewed before Review URL

statusRule: Any blocking FAIL => do not issue Review URL; revise first.
